analysis.object_reference_bank_binding: Reference bank entries (suitcase_001, chair_014, lantern_001, wooden_crate_001) bind identity_signature and anchor_descriptors; recall rules require minimum anchor match against bank entries per batch.
analysis.object_similarity_binding: object_similarity_v1 governs same_object_threshold=0.97 vs similarity_threshold=0.82; validation must not treat similar_object scores as identity lock.
analysis.object_variation_tolerance_binding: variation_tolerance bands (strict/medium/loose) derive lock_strength independently from similarity score; evaluated separately from visual match.
analysis.object_role_binding: object_role_v1 assigns hero_prop > scene_prop > environment_prop > background_furniture priority; role governs narrative lock weight and pass threshold tier.
analysis.object_traceability_binding: traceability_signature links conditioning_map_ref and OBJECT_REFERENCE_BANK_SPECIFICATION for batch audit without GPU execution in this phase.

object_validation_contract.scope: Validation definition only — Validation Defined != Validation Executed.
object_validation_contract.gpu_execution: false — protocol and dataset plan only; execution deferred to future GPU-enabled phase.
object_validation_contract.texture_match_note: Texture Match is part of Object Identity — texture_drift is a first-class object failure mode.

same_object_criteria.same_object: Score >= 0.97 required for same-object identity lock certification.
same_object_criteria.identity_signature_match: Exact object_id or identity_signature hash match with reference_bank_match_score >= 0.97.
same_object_criteria.texture_match: Texture consistency contributes to same_object score; texture_drift below minor_drift triggers degradation review.

object_failure_criteria.identity_embedding_drift: Generated object embedding diverges from identity_signature beyond strict_object threshold.
object_failure_criteria.role_weight_ignored: Hero prop lock weight ignored; role_threshold not applied during conditioning.
object_failure_criteria.variation_tolerance_exceeded: Output drift exceeds variation_tolerance band for bound identity_level.
object_failure_criteria.texture_drift: Surface texture diverges from reference anchor; contributes to object identity score degradation.
object_failure_criteria.missing_accessory: Hard-tier failure: attached accessory absent from generated object.
object_failure_criteria.shape_change: Hard-tier failure: silhouette or geometry inconsistent with reference bank.
object_failure_criteria.identity_swap: Hard-tier failure: wrong object_id rendered in hero prop slot.
object_failure_criteria.hallucinated_object: Hard-tier failure: object not present in reference bank.

object_identity_tiers.note: Hero Prop Defined != Hero Prop Preserved — suitcase_001 and narrative-critical props require highest lock.
Maps to scene_prop and environment_prop roles in object_role_v1 binding.
Maps to background_furniture role; permits higher variation within band.

reference_bank_recall_rules.recall_method: Match generated object anchors against reference bank anchor_descriptors; count kind+importance matches >= minimum_anchor_match across required_reference_count bank entries per batch.
